versions.changelog:
geo-local-optimizer v0.1.0

- Initial release of the geo-local-optimizer skill.
- Provides structured workflows for AI-powered local search optimization focused on local businesses.
- Outlines detailed criteria for when and how to invoke the skill based on user queries involving locality, business types, and search/discovery goals.
- Integrates with other GEO skills for audits, schema generation, and media tagging, coordinating strategy rather than replacing those functions.
- Introduces an 8-step workflow for local optimization, including context capture, audit, and mapping/finding opportunities.
- Outputs actionable summaries and next steps for improving local presence across web and map platforms.
